title: BTSbot workflow automatically confirms and classifies SN 2023tyk
summary: BTSbot selected SN 2023tyk from ZTF alerts and requested robotic spectroscopy; SNIascore supplied its Type Ia classification. The integrated workflow publicly reported the result without human intervention in those steps. This is one transient result, not a new supernova class or a claim that BTSbot alone performed the observation. It preceded the expanded 2024 study.
organization: Northwestern University; California Institute of Technology

evidence.tested: Robotic spectroscopy supported the Type Ia classification.
evidence.unknown: Universal discovery priority and broader workflow completeness were not assessed.
evidence.ai_role: BTSbot convolutional classifier and SNIascore supported the stated study; experimental and interpretive work remained with researchers.

source_review.scope: Indexed primary TNS AstroNote and institutional announcement, plus indexed published-paper abstract. Direct TNS retrieval blocked.
